bindings.caption: Deposit 300-nm-thick Si-doped n-GaAs buffer layer on substrate. Recipe-level vessel: not reported. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Deposit 110-nm-thick undoped GaAs buffer layer on n-doped buffer GaAs . Recipe-level vessel: not reported. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Grow InAs QD layer over undoped GaAs layer. Recipe-level vessel: not reported. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Grow five periods of InAs/GaAs SRL over QD layer. Recipe-level vessel: not reported. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.

Grow 110-nm-thick undoped-GaAs capping layer over SRL layer. Recipe-level vessel: not reported. No vessel assignment is made for this step. Conceptual action diagram. Arrows indicate an action only; no apparatus detail is inferred.
